source: glTF/CarConcept.gltf and derived compiled GLB; pin all source-audit.json inputs
purpose: Resolve near front-right wheel and distinguish changes in illumination from authored material/UV/sampler binding; does not declare a cause or image parity.
reference: Models/CarConcept/screenshot/screenshot_Large.jpg; Sample Viewer Wide Street, original camera/environment rotation/exposure unknown

camera.centerDerivation: Authored WheelFrontR node matrix translation (-0.9766749144,-1.4839684963,0.3837589622), then root BodyUnderside basis and metres-to-inches; no inferred wheel displacement.
camera.qualification: Coordinates are initial inferred camera candidates; verify actual render and revise if wheel is occluded or clipping. Full view and tire ROI are distinct captures. Never call exact reference fit.

illumination.reference: Wide Street HDR environment recorded by model author; actual HDR bytes, orientation and exposure are not available in workspace and must be verified before claiming a matched lighting comparison.
illumination.control: Use an identified, recorded environment plus a second explicitly labelled diagnostic light level or direction, with unchanged camera and material; never change source textures or silently substitute material. Record environment asset SHA, yaw, exposure, tone map, color and positions.
illumination.required: Sample ordinary lit shading, preserve normal and base texture colorspaces and sampler; do not infer physical material fault from differences when IBL differs.

restorationDiagnostic.settling: At each state, perform bounded successive actual RenderToTexture/readback operations on one persistent render target. Record each RGB max and mean difference and require four consecutive full-image zero-delta pairs for a settled state; stop at an explicit bounded maximum and report incomplete if not converged.
restorationDiagnostic.assertions: Capture both default images, settled differences and material binding indices before and after switching; preserve source 68-pixel failure. Separate exact binding reset from image convergence, do not widen the original threshold. Verify empty-before/after and destroyed callback controls.
